headline: Swedish Retailers Forecast 34 Billion SEK Black Week Sales
summary: Industry body Svensk Handel forecasts Swedish retail turnover during Black Week to reach 34 billion SEK ($3.1 billion), with 36% of Swedes planning purchases during the discount period.
why: Black Week sales performance offers an early indicator of consumer discretionary spending capacity across Nordic economies.

impacts.name: Sweden
impacts.why: Strong seasonal retail sales projections support fourth-quarter domestic consumption.
